full_page.content:
Page 35 Cont.
Mar. 23rd W. A. Freer - has wife and small baby in Hospital (St. Mary) asks for prayers that he be enabled to get them home to his other children. - trying to raise hospital bill ..
John Balone - 52 - Nerve -
23 Mrs. Sara Butler - 46 - in Provd. Hosp. rather hopeless - in oxigen tent - unless by prayer.
23 Joseph Joseph - 22 - Serious Kidney T. B ......
Page 36 Mrs. Marie Elder - 37 - has been anxious about lump in breast 1% years . Was here last week and seems better since . ....
Mar. 23 Sam C. House - 89 - Convert away from sacraments 37 yrs. realizes ... has daugher a nun.
26 Mrs. Josephine Miedler -38 - unconscious from Dec. 6-12; was prayed at that time and enrolled at same time. In hospital 8 weeks ... Here To-night able to walk - Deo Gr.
Roberta Mackey -6- measles see March 8
26 Mrs. Anna Frank -69- operation three weeks ago ... successful ... but now Flebites .....
26 Dene Cavanaugh -16-Lukemia, Drs. and nurses all hopeless. Enrolled at 8:45 P.M. Parents here To-day to enroll her again Lymphatic Lukemia said to be most fatal ...... Drs. give her not more that two weeks to live .... gave them relic of Fr. Stephen.
Mrs. M. Schultz - about 43 - blood-clot in leg. ... III Order & Mission Band
Page 37 Mar. 29 Fentan Henk Jr. - 14- bronical pneumonia. Enrolled March 5th when quite hopeless. At very time when enroled fever vanished .... is O.K. since ..
29 Marvin Heuhauser -2-Musculer disop. - very little power in legs & arms. Has a brother with same malidy ( in Lepier)
30 Stanley Stislow - 40- Extremely nerveous; looks healtly; laments he can not go to Church and H. Commun'n; Something holds him back.
